Mark it now, mija — this Sunday the whole room turns pink, glittery, and completely unhinged 💖👑

Revolutionary Riot Productions is throwing the White Gurls Bangers Drag Show at Azúcar, and it's not just any show — it's Sir Knight Haven Rexia's 21st birthday takeover. DJ Phish Tahko's on the boards, Liquor co-hosts, and a stacked lineup of queens is coming for blood: Rohla Blunt, Slayonce, Cherry Pop, Ember Rexia, Fae Tality, Victoria Demizer Night, and Aurora Haven.

Every 2000s/2010s guilty-pleasure banger you screamed into a hairbrush is getting the full drag treatment. Confetti. Chaos. Birthday-girl theatrics. This is a house party dressed up as a drag show — heels on, chill off.

Doors open early, seats fill fast, and this lineup does not repeat. Screenshot it, tag your crew, get there before the room's standing room only.

📅 Sunday, July 19 — Doors 7PM / Show 8PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $15-$25
🔞 21+

Glitter in the air, bass in your chest, hairbrush mic in hand 🎤✨

Picture this: the lights go pink, DJ Phish Tahko drops the first unmistakable notes of a 2000s banger you swore you forgot the words to — and suddenly the whole floor's screaming along. That's the White Gurls Bangers Drag Show energy. Rohla Blunt, Slayonce, Cherry Pop, Ember Rexia, Fae Tality, Victoria Demizer Night, and Aurora Haven turning every guilty pleasure anthem into full-blown performance art.

Sir Knight Haven Rexia's out from behind the DJ booth for her own coronation — 21 and unbothered, hosting alongside Liquor while the room loses it in her honor.

Sequins catching the light, confetti in your drink, strangers becoming your new favorite people by the second chorus. It's girly pop chaos with heels on, and it feels exactly as good as it sounds.

Come exactly as loud as you are 🩷🖤

No dress code except glitter-optional-but-encouraged. The White Gurls Bangers Drag Show at Azúcar is for everybody who's ever screamed a chorus they were embarrassed to admit they knew all the words to. This Sunday, that's the whole point.

Sir Knight Haven Rexia is turning 21 and turning the whole main floor into her personal quinceañera — bestie energy, birthday-girl theatrics, and a full house of queens (Rohla Blunt, Slayonce, Cherry Pop, Ember Rexia, Fae Tality, Victoria Demizer Night, Aurora Haven) ready to hype her all night. DJ Phish Tahko keeps the bangers coming, Liquor's right there co-hosting the madness.

Bring your people, bring your off-key singing voice, bring the energy of someone buying the birthday girl a shot. This room welcomes every body, every vibe, every version of you that wants to dance like nobody's judging — because nobody is.
